description: Zenodo DOI Resolver + DataCite pre-severance metadata batch. Packages the DOI Resolution Index v3.7.2 (AXN:0004, deposit #4) alongside the DataCite metadata backup captured before the 2026-06-19 Zenodo termination. Together these two instruments constitute the empirical foundation for EA-EROSION-01 v1.0 (AXN:0421, deposit #1045) and EA-REMEDIATION-01 v0.2 (pre-mint whitepaper, forthcoming).

records.name: doi-resolution-index.json
records.description: Canonical DOI resolution index v3.7.2 — 1,838 severed Zenodo DOIs mapped to 1,778 valid Alexanarch resolution targets (96%), with structured fallback paths for the remainder. Method A/F/G/B/H/I/J/K/L/N/O recovery methodology preserved in correction_log.

records.name: api/doi-axn-map.json
records.description: Simplified DOI → [AXN, alexanarch_url] map extracted from doi-resolution-index.json for programmatic redirect.

records.description: Full DataCite metadata backup captured 2026-07-03 across the Sharks/heteronym ORCID cluster. Preserved before the 2026-06-19 severance affected downstream metadata state. Approximately 1,817 records with full metadata graphs.

records.name: datacite-survivors-multi-heteronym.json
records.description: Multi-heteronym DataCite survivor snapshot — records that continue to resolve at DataCite despite the Zenodo severance, across the Dodecad heteronym set.
